gloss: to read the room, to pick up on the atmosphere

definitions.gloss: to read the room, to pick up on the atmosphere
definitions.explanation: To sense the mood or unspoken feelings of those around you and act appropriately. A key social skill in Japanese culture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む→空気を読む：06306_kuukiwoyomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上手|じょうず}→上手：00707_jouzu⟧だ。
examples.english: He's good at reading the room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議中|かいぎちゅう}→会議中：16781_kaigichuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}ま→読む：00426_yomu⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{冗談|じょうだん}→冗談：03347_joudan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{言|い}って→言う：00515_iu⟧、⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{凍|こお}った→凍る：02100_kooru⟧。
examples.english: I told a joke without reading the room during the meeting, and everyone went silent.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
Reading the air (⟦{空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む→空気を読む：06306_kuukiwoyomu⟧) is considered a fundamental social skill in Japan. Someone who fails to do this is called KY (⟦{空気|くうき}{読|よ}めない→空気読めない：17655_kuukiyomenai⟧, unable to read the room), which became a popular slang abbreviation.

The particle ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ is sometimes dropped in casual speech: {空気|くうき}{読|よ}んで instead of ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んで→読む：00426_yomu⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む→空気を読む：06306_kuukiwoyomu⟧: to read the room
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}める→読む：00426_yomu⟧: to be able to read the room
- ⟦{空気|くうき}→空気：01390_kuuki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{読|よ}めない→読む：00426_yomu⟧ (KY): unable to read the room
- ⟦{場|ば}→場：03699_ba⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{空気|くうき}を{読|よ}む→空気を読む：06306_kuukiwoyomu⟧: to read the atmosphere of the situation
